dialog.agent:
I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.

**Proposed ad — 8 seconds, landscape 16:9, silent**
- **0–3s:** A white demo screen with a scattered to-do list: “Email Sam,” “Finish proposal,” “Take a walk.”
- **3–6s:** Tasks neatly arrange into a blue-and-white daily plan under “Your day, simplified.”
- **6–8s:** End card: **ClearDay** with a simple blue sun icon and “Less chaos. More clarity.”

I’d use one video generation with the demo interface and branding described in the prompt—no separate logo or screenshot generation charges. AI-generated interface text can be imperfect.

### Cost and cheaper options
Your free-plan video option would be **LTX 2.5 at 480p, with audio off**. However, the connected tools don’t expose an account-balance check or an exact price estimate, and their documentation doesn’t state this model’s credit rate. **I can’t responsibly quote a total for the 8-second video or confirm affordability**, so I won’t submit it.

| Option | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **8 seconds, 480p** | Your requested version; exact cost needs verification. |
| **4–5 seconds, 480p** | A shorter preview that may cost less; savings need a pricing check. |
| **One static ad, 640px** | Free-plan image models advertise pricing **from 5 credits per image**; no animated transformation. |
| **Storyboard and production prompt only** | **0 generation credits**; I can prepare these here. |

480p is already the lowest supported LTX 2.5 video resolution in this tool.

**One important usage note:** Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement—even if a model is available on the free plan.

If you share the current credit quote from Magic Hour, I can help compare the 8-second and shorter versions before you approve any generation.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

## ClearDay ad storyboard
**Format:** 8 seconds · 16:9 landscape · silent  
**Branding:** White background, soft blue accents, navy text, and a simple blue sunrise icon.

| Time | Visual | On-screen text |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3s | A fictional app screen with scattered task cards: “Email Sam,” “Finish proposal,” “Take a walk.” | **Too much to do?** |
| 3–6s | Cards smoothly slide into a tidy daily plan: Morning, Afternoon, Evening. The interface becomes spacious and orderly. | **A simpler plan.** |
| 6–8s | Fade to a clean white end card with the sunrise icon and ClearDay wordmark. | **ClearDay** · Your day, simplified. |

### Ready-to-use video prompt
> Create an 8-second, 16:9 landscape motion-design ad for ClearDay, a fictional daily-planning app. Calm blue-and-white palette, navy sans-serif typography, flat vector-style interface, generous whitespace. Fixed straight-on view; no people or devices. During seconds 0–3, show a messy collection of task cards labeled “Email Sam,” “Finish proposal,” and “Take a walk,” with the headline “Too much to do?” During seconds 3–6, smoothly arrange the same cards into a clean daily plan with Morning, Afternoon, and Evening sections. Headline: “A simpler plan.” During seconds 6–8, transition to a white end card featuring a simple blue sunrise icon, the wordmark “ClearDay,” and the tagline “Your day, simplified.” Keep English text large and minimal. Gentle transitions, no flashing. No sound, music, dialogue, or voiceover.

This is a production plan, not a generated media file, so there’s no download link yet.
